slides.title: Exploring the graph of _y_ = _x_^2
slides.lede: A quadratic function with a U-shaped curve.

keyIdea.title: Key idea
keyIdea.body: Opposite _x_-values give the same _y_-value: if _x_ = _a_, then _x_ = −_a_ gives the same _y_.

keyIdeas.body: The graph of _y_ = _x_^2 is a parabola that opens upwards.
The vertex is at (0, 0), which is the lowest point on the graph.
The graph is symmetrical about the _y_-axis.
All _y_-values are zero or positive (_y_ ≥ 0). Opposite _x_-values give the same _y_-value.
